title: #4771 ci-sentinel: the model runs with no tools
description: ci-sentinel ran claude -p with acceptEdits while reading untrusted CI logs with a comment-writing token. Text rules on commands did not hold (quoted flags, quote-split env reads, gojq transforms of a secret). Now the step fetches the CI data with plain gh, the model reads it with no tools in a read-only job, and a model-free job sanitises and posts the verdict.
